BiblicalUsage: Chor-ashan appears once, in the list of towns to which David sent spoil after recovering Ziklag in 1 Samuel 30:30. It was a town in Judah, and its name means furnace of smoke.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the town's one mention still counts: David shared the spoil with the towns that had stood with him, and God remembers faithfulness in places the map barely notes.
